description: This file defines the GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO class, which serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for date display fields within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It encapsulates a DateTime instance and provides a method to convert it to a formatted string using a helper trait.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for display of date fields in reports, providing string representation of a stored DateTime.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with an optional DateTime object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the stored DateTime using the helper trait.
